Symbols: 12 regular symbols (no wild or scatter)
Direction: Wins are paid left to right only.
Bet Type: Total Bet = Line Bet × 50

Wins are awarded for 3 or more identical symbols appearing consecutively from the leftmost reel.

Each payline pays the highest win per symbol only.

Wins on different paylines are added together.

The payout for each line is calculated as:
Line Bet × Multiplier

All spin results are independent and random.

Only the longest matching combination on each payline pays.

Multiple line wins are added together.

Malfunction voids all pays and plays.

All payouts are shown as multipliers of the line bet.
Total win = sum of all active line wins.
